entities.name: 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator
entities.description: An information element that indicates whether re-attempt is allowed during 5GSM congestion scenarios.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An information element that specifies the back-off timer duration for congestion control.

entities.name: 5GSM cause value #67 or #69
entities.description: Condition where the 5GSM cause value is either #67 'insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN' or #69 'insufficient resources for specific slice'.

relations.description: The 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE can only be included if the Back-off timer value IE is also included.
The 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator IE can only be included if the 5GSM cause value is either #67 or #69.
